hook_text: Imagine going to work four kilometres under the ground.
clip_script: Carletonville, Gauteng. A practice tunnel: dark, low, hot and noisy. Real gold miners ride a cage about four kilometres down. The rock there is about sixty degrees. Giant fans and fridge plants, even ice, cool the air and bring fresh air in. The weight of the rock above can cause rock falls and rockbursts, so props, packs and rock bolts hold it up. And silica dust can cause silicosis, so miners spray water and wear masks.
visual_style: Whiteboard headgear and a shaft plunging down, a thermometer rising, fans and ice, then props holding up a tunnel roof.
mood: Serious and respectful, like honouring hard work.
pacing: Descends step by step, revealing each challenge.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find out how ventilation shafts work.
